description: A jittery, short-lived stimulant. Common in the Franchise Strip.

effects.onset_message: It kicks in. You feel a quick, cheap jolt of energy.

overdose.message: Your chest goes tight and your heart races far too fast.

comedown_message: It drops you. The cheap ones always drop you.
You crash, and you're useless for the rest of the afternoon.
You crash, and you feel awful.
phases.comeup_message: Your hands stop feeling like yours. Everything speeds up.
peak_message: You're jittery all at once, and you go with it.
You speed up, and everything feels easy.
Cheap and fast, exactly as advertised.

withdrawal.message: You're slow and tired, and everything takes twice as long.

stages.easing: Your head clears enough to hold one job in it at a time.
stages.onset: The jitter goes, and takes your footing with it.
stages.peak: You're heavy in a way sleep doesn't fix, and you have tried, twice, for eleven minutes each.
stages.rising: Your eyes are gritty and you have read the same sign three times on the way past it.
stages.tail: Working order, at the speed you were always working at before you were wrong about it.

name: buzz
